description:
Install an idempotent NIGHTLY backup: a script (pg_dump of the prod DB +
    tar of the filestore, timestamped into `dest`, keeping the newest `keep`) plus
    a systemd service + timer. dry_run shows the script file + install steps;
    confirm writes + enables them. Non-destructive to prod.

    OFF-SITE (optional): pass `remote_dest="user@host:/path"` to ALSO push each night's
    newest dump+filestore off the box over SSH, prune the remote to `remote_keep`
    (default = `keep`), and verify by sha256. The remote only needs sshd + rsync + a
    writable path - no Odoo/Postgres there. On confirm the box mints a dedicated ed25519
    key and returns its PUBLIC key with `status=blocked_on_human` until you add that key
    to the remote's `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`; re-run with the same `remote_dest` to
    finish. This keeps a copy safe against total loss of the box, not just db corruption.

    OFF-SITE TO OBJECT STORAGE (optional, independent of the above): pass `s3_bucket=...`
    after `offsite_s3_setup` has configured the box. Each night the dump goes to
    `sql/<db>/` (kept `s3_sql_days`), on the 1st of the month also to `monthly/` (kept
    `s3_monthly_days`, because corruption is sometimes only noticed a quarter later), and the
    filestore is copied FILE BY FILE (`rclone copy`, never `sync` - sync would delete on the
    remote side, and the files are immutable so only new attachments travel). Every upload is
    confirmed by comparing the object's size in the bucket; anything unconfirmed fails the run.
    This needs no second machine of your own - no bucket credentials pass through this tool.

    `push_url` (optional): a monitoring push endpoint (e.g. Uptime Kuma). It is told "up"
    ONLY after the whole chain, off-site copy included, is confirmed - a green monitor over a
    broken off-site backup is worse than no monitor.
name: backup_setup
